elements.title: Multiple Linear Regression

legend/series: green lines: line segments from actual to predicted points
details.values: scatter points densely clustered along the regression plane, with W values increasing as BARTHAG increases and WAB varies; green vertical lines connect actual points to predicted points on the plane

elements.summary: This 3D scatter plot visualizes actual data points (blue dots) and their predicted values on a regression plane (colored surface) for a multiple linear regression model with features BARTHAG and WAB predicting W. Green lines connect actual points to their predicted points, illustrating prediction errors.
